questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : The esterification of carboxylic acid with an alcohol is a nucleophilic acyl substitution.

Statement II : Electron withdrawing groups in the carboxylic acid will increase the rate of esterification reaction.

Choose the most appropriate option :

options.content: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

questions.explanation:
Esterification of carboxylic acid with an alcohol is
nucleophilic acyl substitution and presence of
electron withdrawing group in the carboxylic acid
increases the rate of esterification reaction.
